title: Large index stream fetch clone reduction
scope: large index scan row fetch stream and primary-key key-only row construction

summary: Added primary_key_row_from_parts so key-only rows can be built from schema width and precomputed primary-key type metadata.
Replaced per-row table-name String clones in the large index fetch stream with Arc<str> sharing.
Replaced per-row projection-index Vec clones with Arc<[usize]> sharing.
Removed per-row schema columns cloning and temporary TableSchema construction from the key-only stream path.
Added a primary-key IN regression with 80 row ids to cover the stream branch and prove payload bytes are not decoded for key-only projection.

next_task_signals: Continue database-core performance iterations from the next focused scan/query hot path.
